name: apple-connector
description: Connect Apple native apps to Raycast.
author: atahanyorganci

ai.instructions:
All timestamps in this extension are Unix seconds (UTC) as integers, never RFC 3339 strings. Convert the user's natural-language dates into Unix seconds before calling a tool, and convert returned values back into readable dates when answering.

Messages is read-only: there is no tool to send, reply to, or delete a message. If the user asks to send one, say so and offer to open Messages.app instead.

Locked notes never expose body text. get-note-contents returns isLocked: true with no contents for them; report that rather than implying the note is empty.

Tool results are capped at 25 items. If the user needs more, narrow the query rather than asking for a larger limit.

Reminders priority is 0 none, 1 high, 5 medium, 9 low — not a 1-5 scale.

search-messages.text: the lease renewal is due friday
